name: Particles, glow and light
summary: Seeded sparks, dust, motes and trails plus additive glow, thresholded bloom, sweeps and glints.
qualityBar: Deterministic: same seed, same particles; none before t0 or after the longest life
Analytic particle positions match step-by-step integration within 1 px (measured 0.003 px)
Motes loop exactly every period and stay in their box
Glow, bloom, sweep and glint verified on real pixels (falloff, halo, dim panels unchanged, clipped to box)
Full-frame bloom plus 120 particles under 250 ms per frame (measured about 60 ms)
Demo: flat vs lit hit, QC passes
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (34 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, 1080x1920, silent; engine QC on the card and the mp4 passed, 2 warnings). I viewed out/contact.png and a full-size crop of the impact frame and judged them good (found and fixed a visible brightness rectangle from bloom by adding a threshold). NOT checked: motion played back by a person; confetti mode (square) is implemented but not used in the demo and only drawn, not unit-tested on pixels; timing cost measured on a shared machine so numbers are noisy; no audio.
